description: The Unihedron Sky Quality Meter (SQM) is a compact photometer widely used for measuring night-sky brightness and light pollution in visual magnitudes per square arcsecond.
facility_description: The Sky Quality Meter is a portable commercial and observatory-mounted night-sky photometer manufactured by Unihedron.

links.label: Sanchez de Miguel et al. (2017) Sky Quality Meter measurements in a colour-changing world

notes: Sanchez de Miguel et al. (2017) describe the SQM sensor as a TAOS TSL237S light-to-frequency converter partly covered by a HOYA CM-500 near-infrared cut-off filter, and work in AB magnitudes for SQM readings (not Vega); they compare SQM with Johnson B and V and the scotopic/photopic eye responses.
